mn_miic.name: Minnesota Immunization Information Connection (MIIC)
mn_miic.description: Immunization coverage data from the Minnesota Immunization Information Connection (MIIC). Includes vaccination rates for early childhood (24 months), middle childhood (6 years), and adolescent (13 years) age groups, reported by birth year cohort. County-level and statewide data are available, along with race/ethnicity breakdowns at the state level.
mn_miic.restrictions: Public domain. Minnesota Department of Health data is freely available for public use.
